subject: Pharmacokinetics & Molecular Pharmacology
topic: Hepatic Clearance: Mathematical Elimination Models vs. Cytochrome P450 Enzyme Kinetics
syllabus_context: Module 3: Organ Clearance, Hepatic First-Pass Metabolism, and Microsomal Kinetics
declared_learning_objective: Differentiate algebraic hepatic clearance formulas from cellular microsomal enzyme transport mechanisms; define extraction ratio and portal vein blood flow; and evaluate intrinsic clearance governed by Michaelis-Menten kinetics.

contrast_design.targeted_pattern: Pattern 2: Empirical Mechanism vs Mathematical Identity
contrast_design.negative_distinction: Algebraic kinetic parameter equations without physiological liver tissue
contrast_design.positive_distinction: Cellular transport via sinusoidal Space of Disse, CYP3A4 Michaelis-Menten kinetics, and intrinsic clearance
